How much is a used Polo Ralph Lauren cable-knit sweater worth?

Ralph Lauren cable knits are among the best-selling second-hand knitwear on Vinted and eBay. Material and condition matter more than anything else.

Updated 2026-11-06 · by FlipLens

Which one do you have?

The care label inside shows the material: cotton, wool, cashmere or blends. Cashmere and wool sell for more than cotton. The embroidered pony on the chest should be neat and evenly stitched.

What decides the price

  • Material: cashmere above wool, wool above cotton.
  • Size: common sizes sell fastest; check the label, not the seller's description.
  • Colour: classic colours such as navy, cream and green sell well.
  • Condition: pilling, holes and stretched cuffs lower the price.
  • Authenticity: fakes exist; look at the pony, the labels and the stitching.

Check before you buy

  • Read the care label for the material and size.
  • Look for moth holes against the light.
  • Check the cuffs and hem for stretching.
  • Compare the logo with a genuine one.

Where it sells best

Sells best on Vinted, and on eBay for larger sizes. Photograph the labels and the knit close up.

Today's price

Prices for a used Polo Ralph Lauren cable-knit sweater change every week, so this page gives no fixed numbers.
